The '''MK line droid''' was a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was similar to the [[Seneschal-series factotum droid|2V-series factotum droid]]. [[MK-RU]] was a MK line droid.<ref name="TOR" />
